lead: Martin's Sweet Shop at 214 E Washington Ave: more than 30 flavors of hand-dipped Blue Bell, Italian ices, soda floats and candy. Texas Highways sends visitors for the creamsicle soda float. 4.9 stars from 110 Google reviews.
svc_text: Typical bakery services. Martin's Sweet Shop would confirm the real list and prices.
about: Martin's Sweet Shop is a corner shop at 214 E Washington Ave in downtown Navasota.
Martin Price started selling ice cream from a cart in Brooklyn when he was 14, and more than 50 years later runs his own shop. Texas Highways recommends the creamsicle soda float.
Customers have given it 4.9 stars across 110 Google reviews.
